procedural_matters: Steve Schupak witnessed the incident and provided testimony during the hearing.
facts: Steven Schupak was acting as an Appendix P observer and was in a RIB 25 meters from the leeward gate.
Steven Wolff, another App P observer riding with Steven Schupak, signaled a penalty as per APP P, 1.2 for a violation of RRS 42.
222189 responded and loudly stated: “Are you fucking kidding me”
In the hearing, 222189 apologized and took full responsibility.
conclusions: Emerson Wadell failed to compete in compliance with the principles of sportsmanship and fair play as stated in RRS Basic Principles. 222189 broke RRS 2.
decision: The Protest Committee issued 222189 a written warning.
